The Golem was an artificial man which was supposed to have been constructed by the rabbi Judah Lowe (1510-1609) of Prague for the purpose of guarding and defending the Jews, and who was supposed to have been brought into existence by means of the secret name of God and the letters of the Holy Pentateuch; when the Rabbi wished to destroy it he removed the first letter of the word EMET [truth], or life, so that the word became MET [death] and the Golem died. See "Golem," Jewish Encyclopedia, New York, 1905.<|endoftext|>
